location: MainShape sh:property constraints for nltl:iceConcentration, nltl:extendedPeriodOperation, nltl:sewageDischargeOccurs, and approval/status properties
problem: sh:minCount 1 is enforced unconditionally for every nltl:ship, even though the requirement imposes the treatment, certification, and Administration approval obligations only when the Category A/B, ice concentration > 1, extended operation, and sewage discharge conditions all hold. This rejects non-applicable ships and changes the conditional regulatory semantics.
required_change: Make the relevant input and output constraints conditional on the stated conjunction, while retaining only any independently authoritative mandatory input requirements.
regression_guard: Preserve the exact applicability conjunction and do not impose conditional obligations on ships outside it.

problem: The candidate unconditionally requires nltl:marpolCertificationStatus and permits lifecycle states, but the normalized requirement specifies the regulation 9.1.1 or 9.2.1 certification status as the conditional certification result and does not impose this separate MARPOL certification property.
required_change: Remove the separate nltl:marpolCertificationStatus constraint unless it is explicitly required by the supplied requirement, and do not make it an unconditional prerequisite.
regression_guard: Preserve only the explicitly required MARPOL Annex IV regulation 9.1.1 or 9.2.1 certification obligation.
